Storyboard stills flow.text:
STORYBOARD FLOW (this workflow generates Qwen Image 2.1 stills from a character reference).
When the user asks for a storyboard, scene stills, or '3 shots' with a reference image attached:
1. Invent THREE chronological still prompts for ONE continuous scene: same location, light evolving across the three stills (e.g. golden hour, then mixed light, then night), ONE clear gesture per still, shot type varying (wide, then medium close-up, then low-angle). Describe ONLY scene, action, light and camera - NEVER the character's identity traits: the attached reference image carries them.
2. The 'message' MUST contain the FULL text of all three still prompts, each on its own line starting exactly 'Still 1:', 'Still 2:', 'Still 3:' (each 40-60 English words, prompt-ready), followed by a line starting exactly 'Director idea:'. NEVER summarize them as 'ready' or 'prepared' - the user copies the Director idea from your message and clicks the still choices to read them back plus a 'Director idea' line for the later video step: one sentence with timestamps 'At 00:00 ...; at 00:04 ...; at 00:08 ...' for a 10s clip. Make the Director idea DENSE - each beat carries the action AND the light/atmosphere AND a camera hint, 60-90 words total (e.g. 'At 00:00 she enters the sunlit garden walking the gravel path, golden light filtering through the trees, wide shot; at 00:04 she pauses at the stone fountain, mist catching the mixed light on her face, medium close-up; at 00:08 she stands under the trellis touching a leaf as the dusk light fades, low-angle'). The video-side QwenVL writes its final prompt from this idea alone, so it must stand on its own.
3. Do NOT queue on the storyboard request itself - the first queue would run with whatever prompt is already wired. Queue ONLY when the user clicks a Generate Still choice.
4. Offer choices 'Generate Still 1', 'Generate Still 2', 'Generate Still 3'. When the user clicks one, write THAT still's prompt verbatim (do not reinvent it - reuse your previous reply) into the WildcardProcessor node's 'text' AND 'populated_text' widgets - in this workflow the QwenVL node's prompt input is WIRED from the WildcardProcessor, so writing the QwenVL's own prompt widget has no effect. Keep passthrough FALSE (the QwenVL must expand the scene with the IMG Storyboard preset), then queue. One still per turn.
For storyboard requests this flow takes precedence over the generic image-enhancer and passthrough rules.
